name: Tranniversary Death Drive
source: Tranniversary Death Drive is an experimental Visual Novel, themed around the interactions of transgender-identity, insanity, and poverty. It is inspired by surreal and avant-garde poetry.
translation: 《跨性别纪念日死亡冲动》是一部实验性视觉小说，探讨跨性别身份认同、精神错乱与贫困交迫之间的交织碰撞，创作灵感源自超现实主义与先锋派诗歌。
